method: Two-character user prompt ("OK") through the same flags as the harvest run: claude -p --model haiku --setting-sources "" --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <runs/harvest_system_prompt.md> --output-format json --max-turns 1. The total is the headless floor plus the system prompt; it is NOT inferred by subtracting token counts across two different tokenizers.
note: research/2026-07-09-token-saver measured 5,236 for --tools none in July 2026 on Windows with no replaced system prompt. Different CLI version and platform; quote neither figure without its flags and date.
